fixture_notes: Probe dates are anchored on the facility-local day: versions publish at 23:59 yesterday (the latest backdate 338 allows) and d0 is today; a run in the first twenty minutes after local midnight is outside the fixture (the drill instants would fall in the previous period).
Hosted Supabase default table privileges for authenticated/service_role on drill_log are stubbed in the probe header (the replay stub lacks them); RLS and the lifecycle guard are the real controls.
The previous-period fire occurrence is minted directly under the occurrence token, as the 346 probe does, because the 340 generator pins governing versions at the due instant.
